text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'd like to get everyone's weight data, if possible...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Surveillance has been rather strict lately.
It makes it difficult to get my hands on everyone's data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I try sneaking into the data management room,
the door might have multiple locks on it or something...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so,
I ended up reaching out to a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Yes, it's Air Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If it's her, she surely has plenty of data
hidden up her sleeve!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, I'd like to ask for your help!
Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No way, I refuse. Go ask someone else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, what an instant refusal! Couldn't you think about it for just a second?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kidding me. I went through hell
to get this data. No way in hell I'm giving it up for free.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, that makes total sense.
In that case—alright.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'll give you a special preview of the new drug I plan to develop next—!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Then, as for this prototype
Umamusume Instinct Activation Drink—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want that even if you begged me.
Don't you have anything better?
choice_data_list: I wonder if Tachyon's medicine will help at all...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean they're all too groundbreaking
for the general public to appreciate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... In that case, all that's left is a pill that provides a week's worth of nutrients in a single dose...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I guess it's better than the rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Alright, try drinking this. If there are no issues
after a week, I'll trade it for the weight list.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, we have a deal!
Then Trainer-kun, without further ado—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait. That might not have the same effect
on an Umamusume. You drink it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Well, that has a point, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Very well! Observe me closely
after I drink this potion!"
Agnes Tachyon happily pulled out some medicine from her skirt and downed it in one hearty gulp.
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!
Pffft...! Ahaha, ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... I-I can't stop laughing... Ahaha!
What is this! I-It won't st... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't need that medicine.

Air Shakur walked away from the spot
with an exasperated look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
Finally stopped, huh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"To think I wouldn't be able to stop laughing.
I suppose the negotiation was a failure, then."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, this just made acquiring data difficult
again. What to do now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Is that the only one?
In that case, we'll have to find another way, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
How about we secretly install a scale into the chair?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A classroom chair would get caught immediately, so if I'm gonna set a trap, it's gotta be on the school bus seats...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! First, we obtain the bus key!
Lend me your aid, Trainer-kun!

Since it was completely out of the question no matter how you looked at it,
I convinced them to give up on
the bus plan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I suppose we really can't spend all our time
just looking at weight data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trusting that a chance to gather information will come along eventually,
let's move forward with what we can do right now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Time is finite, and we can't let it go to waste.
—And so with that in mind...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: For now, why don't we try running a few tests on the subject right in front of us!

"With gleaming eyes, Agnes Tachyon patted my back,
and a new physical enhancement experiment
was initiated..."
